name: Tiramisu Overnight Oats
description: Creamy chocolate-espresso overnight oats topped with a vanilla protein yoghurt layer and a dusting of cacao. Make ahead and refrigerate overnight. Nutrition figures are supplied estimates per serving.

steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, combine the rolled oats, cacao powder, chia seeds and a pinch of salt.
Pour in the cooled espresso, almond milk, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Stir until evenly mixed, then divide between two sealable jars or transfer to one larger airtight container.
In a separate bowl, whisk the vanilla yoghurt with 1/2 tbsp honey, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract and vanilla protein powder until smooth and creamy.
Spoon the protein yoghurt topping evenly over the oat mixture and smooth the surface. Lightly dust with additional cacao powder.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Serve chilled; if stored together in one container, divide into two portions before eating.
